 The Verge The Verge logo. Notifications Notifications Posted Nov 10, 2026 at 2:00 PM UTC J Jay Peters Tubi is going to let you make “mixtapes” to recommend shows and films. You can hand-select every title or have Tubi help assemble something for you that you can work with, and then you can share your Mixtape with other people. Seems basically like a playlist feature, but for things on Tubi.
